description: This source file defines the OpenmrsConfigurationFactory class responsible for loading and configuring log4j2 logging configurations for the OpenMRS system. It handles multiple configuration file formats (XML, YAML, JSON), applies customizations such as adding a memory appender, and allows override of log levels via administrative properties.

classes.name: OpenmrsConfigurationFactory
classes.description: A factory class extending Log4j2's ConfigurationFactory to load, customize, and manage logging configurations for OpenMRS, supporting multiple file formats and applying custom appenders and log levels.

classes.name: OpenmrsXmlConfiguration
classes.description: Extends XmlConfiguration to customize the XML logging configuration with OpenMRS-specific settings.

classes.name: OpenmrsYamlConfiguration
classes.description: Extends YamlConfiguration to customize the YAML logging configuration with OpenMRS-specific settings.

classes.name: OpenmrsJsonConfiguration
classes.description: Extends JsonConfiguration to customize the JSON logging configuration with OpenMRS-specific settings.

methods.name: getConfiguration(LoggerContext loggerContext, String name, URI configLocation)
methods.description: Attempts to load the logging configuration from specified location or application data directory, supporting multiple configuration files.

methods.name: getConfiguration(LoggerContext loggerContext, ConfigurationSource source)
methods.description: Creates a specific configuration object based on source format (XML, YAML, JSON) with customizations.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes()
methods.description: Returns the list of supported configuration file suffixes.

methods.name: getConfigurationFiles()
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts configuration files from application data directories based on prefix and readability.

methods.name: doOpenmrsCustomisations(AbstractConfiguration configuration)
methods.description: Adds in-memory appender if missing and applies global log level settings from administrative properties.

methods.name: applyLogLevels(AbstractConfiguration configuration, AdministrationService adminService)
methods.description: Reads global log level settings and applies them to specific loggers.

methods.name: applyLogLevel(AbstractConfiguration configuration, String loggerName, String loggerLevel)
methods.description: Sets the log level for a specific logger based on configuration.
